card.name: Words leading up to odor or smell
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'odor' or 'smell', such as 'bad', 'foul', 'strong', 'garlic' or 'a', in descriptions of discharge, wounds or breath. Also fires on a few other linking words in symptom lists.

modes.label: Descriptor before odor
modes.description: An adjective or modifier that sets up 'odor' or 'smell' for discharge, fluid or breath.

modes.description: Words in 'garlic breath' or 'foul breath odor' phrases, often in lists of signs of toxicity or illness.

modes.description: A linking word such as 'such' that starts a list of symptoms.

card.writes: It pushes the model to say odor or smell next.
card.plain: It spots wording that is about to describe a smell, like a foul-smelling discharge or garlic breath.
